en: <CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>They really are everywhere...
They want us to know we're under their control.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it doesn't have any surveillance
equipment to spy on us.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."
